verdict.rationale: Medusa Cloud advertises 'Instant previews on PRs', which suggests non-production preview environments. Its open-source modules (on npm) also imply you can run an instance locally, separate from production. Neither source explicitly documents a sandbox with data isolated from production. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of sandbox/test environments, confirmation that preview environments use separate databases rather than production data, agent-facing sandbox workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
